title: Purair® FLOW Laminar Flow Cabinets
meta_title: Purair FLOW Laminar Flow Cabinets - Vertical Airflow Hoods
meta_description: Purair FLOW Series benchtop laminar flow cabinets provide vertical laminar airflow with HEPA/ULPA filtration to protect equipment and contents from particulates.
meta_keywords: laminar flow cabinets, vertical laminar flow, HEPA filtration, clean benches, laboratory equipment
short_description: Purair® FLOW Series benchtop laminar flow cabinets are compact and ideal for laboratory environments with limited space. The vertical laminar flow hoods use HEPA filtration to protect equipment and other contents of the work zone from particulates.
full_description: Vertical laminar airflow with HEPA/ULPA filtration protects materials inside the cabinet from particulates. High efficiency ebm-papst centrifugal fan. Air cleanliness meets and exceeds ISO Class 5. Energy saving LED lighting. Large front opening provides unrestricted access to the work zone.
seo_content: The Purair FLOW Series of vertical laminar flow cabinets offer precise, ISO Class 5 air cleanliness for a wide range of laboratory applications. These compact, benchtop units feature high-efficiency HEPA or ULPA filtration to remove 99.99% of airborne particulates, ensuring a clean work environment for sensitive samples, materials, and processes. With a large front access opening and ergonomic design, the FLOW Series provides unrestricted access to the work zone while maintaining optimal airflow and contamination control.
features_data: Vertical laminar airflow with HEPA/ULPA filtration
